title: CNH — Carteira Nacional de Habilitação
description: The Brazilian driver's license registry number.

format.summary: Formats a Brazilian CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação) number.
description: Formats a CNH number as `000000000-00` (9 digits, hyphen, 2 check digits).
- `options.pad` left-pads the value with zeros to 11 digits first.

generate.summary: Generates a valid random CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação, the Brazilian driver's license number).
description: Generates a valid random CNH number: 11 digits, unformatted, that pass `cnh.isValid`.

tests.name: generated-is-valid
tests.note: every generated value must pass the lib's own validator

isValid.summary: Validates if a CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação, the Brazilian driver's license number) is valid.
description: Validates a CNH registry number: 9 digits plus 2 check digits (Resolução CONTRAN nº 886/2021, art. 4º).
- Spaces, dots and hyphens are ignored; any other character makes the value invalid.
- A value whose 11 digits are all the same is rejected.

- Pending decision (findings §1): the reference (JS) keeps a remainder of 1 in the first check digit as `1`, as real registry numbers do (art. 4º § 1º says `0`); Python and Erlang implement a different (2022) algorithm.
